description: Boundary corpus (#973): for every version and level, one BYTE segment of exactly the version's maximum byte count, byte i = (149*i + floor(i/251) + 7*version + 41*levelOrdinal) mod 256, encoded by the oracle's real encode_segments (versions 1-40, ECC boost disabled) at forced mask (version + levelOrdinal) mod 8; then the same formula one byte longer with automatic mask. Texts: the listed payloads, automatic version and mask. codewords_sha256: the complete interleaved stream passed to _draw_codewords; final_sha256: the finished grid, metadata included, one 0/1 byte per cell; penalties: the eight _get_penalty_score trials.
